title: Fair ranking: a critical review, challenges, and future directions
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks and does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It is a critical review of fair ranking literature.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. The discussion of fairness and protected attributes focuses on examples like race and gender.
